evidence.detail: Completionist SQL counts all d.retired=1 decks but description says 'without retiring an unfinished league run' — decks with 5 matches are finished but still trigger the condition
description_safe explicitly says 'unfinished' but SQL has no match-count guard
5 matches is the league completion threshold per the form validation message
deck.is_finished checks wins+draws+losses >= 5 OR self.retired, confirming retired and 5-match are independent states

triage.fix_sketch: In decksite/data/achievements.py:815, change the Completionist SQL from `COUNT(CASE WHEN d.retired = 1 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) = 0` to `COUNT(CASE WHEN d.retired = 1 AND (COALESCE(dc.wins, 0) + COALESCE(dc.draws, 0) + COALESCE(dc.losses, 0)) < 5 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) = 0`. The dc alias (deck_cache) is already joined in the preaggregate query (achievements.py:103). This makes the SQL match the description 'without retiring an unfinished league run'.
triage.notes: The 83 retired-but-5-match decks directly cause the Completionist achievement to be incorrectly denied. dc is a LEFT JOIN so COALESCE is needed for decks with no cache row.
